name: sponsorblockcast
description: Bash script to detect sponsor segments in YouTube videos played over Chromecast on your network. It is STRONGLY recommended that you also add an hourly user script to "docker restart sponsorblockcast" (assuming you don't rename the container). You MUST set this container to use the Host network. **Please note, this is not my script or application - support for CA Apps template only** **This script is known to cause high CPU usage after a period of time (usually 24 hrs) - the user script restarts the container regularly so data doesn't build up to the level of impacting your system**

variables.name: SBCYOUTUBEAPIKEY
variables.description: For instructions to get an API key, visit: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/getting-started
